properties.Accommodation:
On-campus Housing
UNSW affiliated Colleges and Apartments provide high quality accommodation and you should apply directly to the College or Apartment as early as possible. On campus accommodation is extremely limited and is not guaranteed even if you apply by the deadline. 

Off-campus Housing
Most exchange students choose to live off campus and enjoy the beautiful suburbs that surround UNSW. Sydney is a safe city, with public transport connecting the UNSW campuses, beaches, and city centre. We recommend students arrive 1-2 weeks early to find off campus accommodation. You may wish to book temporary accommodation to allow time to find more permanent housing.
* Off campus support offered by UNSW accommodation team https://www.unsw.edu.au/student/student-life/campus/accommodation
properties.Restrictions:
*Courses NOT Available to Exchange Students:
  - MBA Coursework
  - Courses that are part of the Honours degree (4xxx)
  - UNSW Canberra at the Australian Defence Force Academy (all courses starting with ‘z’)
  - UNSW College
  - Doctor of Medicine program
**Computer Science courses are competitive to enrol in.
**Law courses enrolment restricted to law majors. 
*3.0 GPA out of 4.0 scale
*Students should have completed 1 year of study prior to exchange.
*Generally undergradaute students are not able to enrol in graduate courses, but there may be some limited options for Law and some Science and Engineering subjects.
*Exchange students are limited to taking one online course only.
properties.Note:
You are required to enrol in a full-time load at UNSW. The normal full-time load is 18 units of credit per term and 24 units of credit for tailored terms (3 subjects per term or 4 subjects per tailored term). It is not possible to overload or underload.

Exchange Office
Email: exchange@unsw.edu.au
Visit us on the web at https://www.unsw.edu.au/ or https://www.unsw.edu.au/study/international-students/study-abroad#studentexchange

- The first and foremost aim of our program is to foster students’ language acquisition and ability to communicate with many types of Japanese speakers in a variety of interactive situations. properties.Notes:
*Course Approval & Denial :  After admission, students will be asked to complete the ASP&E Course Request Form. Through this form, students will be asked to select up to 10 courses of interest. These courses will be reviewed by the corresponding MSU college. Decisions about enrollment eligibility will be made based on the students transcripts and academic background, along with any supporting coursework the student provides to accompany the form. (https://americansemester.isp.msu.edu/interested-students/about-academics/exchange-course-availability/ )
*MSU requires that all students enrolling in classes be vaccinated and boosted (3 doses) against COVID-19
with a World Health Organization approved vaccine. Vaccination must be completed prior to course
enrollment. Students will be asked to verify their vaccination status prior to enrolling in classes.
*Insurance : Tuition does not include mandatory student health insurance. This cost ranges from semester to semester; for reference, the average cost is typically between $1,400-$1,800 per semester depending on semester duration. Students must be prepared to take this insurance, as students are not permitted to opt out of MSU’s health insurance policy, even if the home university or government supplies insurance.
*Housing Office now requires a $50 non-refundable application fee and a $175 advanced housing payment (which is applied to the contract cost). These are not yet reflected in the cost section of the factsheet but should be accounted for when financial planning.
